locked_rules: UGC from real homes is the biggest gap
specs on frame 1 for ads: material, size, warm 3000K, no bulbs included, free shipping
Rubik's Cube / Glass Block lamp must show at least two colours, never a static single glow
Aurora never outdoors, never implies weather resistance
Scandinavian Rosewood Pendant is Rosewood-only in creative, never Teakwood
discard any generation that breaks these
never deploy a creative that hasn't been visually confirmed
never run duplicate creatives in one ad set
real footage over renders for hero images (the one AI-rendered problem image was the account's lowest-quality ad)
no dispatch-time claims while backlogged; no lumens/CRI claims without a datasheet

preflight.check: locked rule check pass/fail per rule
landing = the product shown, page passes .nw-pdp template and shows stock
visual confirmation by Rameez (watch the mp4, not the sheet)
named control in the same ad set, never a replacement
kill threshold written on the ad

engine.kill_threshold: ₹1,500 spend with 0 purchases, or 7d ROAS below the ad-set average after ≥₹3,000
engine.test_threshold: ≥8 purchases at ≥4x within 14 days against the control (Rubik's); CTR +20% and CPA ≤ control at ≥₹3,000 each (H1)

_layout.note: Each product has a folder under nixwoods-reel/ named by products.<key>.root. Inside it: src/ real footage, audio/ music+VO+SFX, hf/ generated stills and clips, ref/ design reference, out/ renders. Asset paths in this file are relative to that folder, so make_reel.py needs no --root for a product declared here.
add_a_product: 2. put real footage in src/, a reference frame per angle in ref/, write ref/REFERENCE.md describing the true product form
4. add products.<key> here: root, name, price, url, copy, assets, facts
5. generate stills with the template in <name>-reels/hf/PROMPTS.md, then python3 system/qa.py --root <name>-reels to approve or reject each one
6. copy a brief from system/briefs/, set product, render

drive.note: Files up to 10 MB download via download_file_content (oversized results are written to ~/.claude/projects/<project>/tool-results/ as JSON {content: base64}; decode from disk, never through context). Over 10 MB the connector refuses outright, which rules out all 18 raw shoot clips at 19-25 MB. Reel photography comes from the public Shopify product CDN. Full detail: nixwoods-reel/DRIVE-MAP.md
